title: Urgent Report for Duke Ravengard
summary: Pass option for Wyrm’s Crossing and Wyrm’s Rock Fortress.

fields.Use: Carry it to unlock a dialogue option telling the Flaming Fist that the party has an urgent message for Duke Ravengard. Using this pass grants Multipass Inspiration to Nobles. Successful paper-based entry can also grant Rock-Solid Alibi.
fields.Acquisition: On a cupboard behind Danzo at Sword Coast Couriers in Rivington at (15, 12).

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
